Name: Poly Friendly Events - Content Patcher
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: A polyamory friendly rewrite of two cutscenes added in the 1.3 beta.
Description:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD FROM ANYWHERE EXCEPT HERE, MODDROP, OR MY GITHUB
Other websites are stealing mods from Nexus and uploading them without permission, while earning money on each mod they steal.  My mods are always found on the three sites listed above and no where else.

While testing some other mods in the new 1.3 beta, I ran across two new heart scenes that I immediately decided needed to have alternative results.  After much trial and error, I present to you my edits of the "anti-poly" heart scenes.  Now all of your hard work wooing the marriage candidates will not go to waste, with bonus acknowledgement of the poly-amorous arrangement you have with your date mates.

As of 1.1.0, I've now started on dialogue modification, with help from my writer [Shwetan](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/38486275)﻿.  Please give them some love!

Note that if you have a rabbit's foot in your inventory, the alternative scenes CA added after the initial uproar will indeed play instead of these modded scenes.  As of right now, I'm not sure how to change that.

Please note that I am not a writer by any means, so if anyone would like to contribute dialogue changes (or even dialogue for brand new scenes!), please contact me. 

This mod requires [Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915) to work!

WORKS WITH SDV 1.4!

**Install**

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).

2.  [Install Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915).

3.  Download this mod and unzip it, then copy  the '[CP] Poly Friendly Cutscenes' folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.

4.  You're done; run the game!

**Update log**

*   1.1.2 - Hopefully fixes the events not working properly.  A conflict with Gender Neutrality Mod was found (thanks Kibbleknight#5081 for the help tracking it down!) and resolved.

*   1.1.1 - Moves jealousy dialogue entirely over to [UJR](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3957)﻿.

*   1.1.0 - Changes jealousy dialogue to be more positive, consolidates both versions into one (thanks for the head's up Karmylla!)

*   1.0.2 -  Fixes events so they now work with 1.3.33+.  Thank you very much to [coldazrael](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/29644045)﻿ for the unofficial update in my absence, it was much appreciated!  Both events are also now skippable (mostly because testing this mod is a pain otherwise).

*   1.0.1 - Fixed SMAPI key

*   1.0.0 - Initial version
Thanks to [Mal](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/37328775)﻿ and [tenthousandcats](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/50579086) for the inspiration (and a bit of formatting help) from their excellent cutscene mods.

If you like my mods, please consider checking out my [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/minervamaga)﻿ or [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/U7U69L0R)﻿!

Source code found [here](https://github.com/minervamaga?tab=repositories)﻿.  Feel free to [submit a pull request](https://help.github.com/en/articles/creating-a-pull-request)﻿ with improvements or translations.  You can also [report issues or request features using the Issues tab](https://help.github.com/en/articles/creating-an-issue)﻿!
